resources.string:
Take turns dropping a disc into one of the %1$d columns. Tap anywhere in a column: the disc falls to the lowest empty slot.

Connect %2$d of your discs in a straight line, across, up and down, or diagonally, to win the board. If all %3$d slots fill up with no line of %2$d, it's a tie.

Play Again keeps the session tally, and the player who moves first alternates each board.
